signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary action button fill, active link states, focus indicators — the single chromatic action color in an otherwise achromatic system

amber-alert.$description: Amber Alert — Download CTA, high-priority callouts, notification accents — warm yellow against dark surfaces for the conversion moment

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Dark section backgrounds, announcement bar, hero gradient base — the midnight-violet that makes screens glow

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Dark card surfaces, deepest background layer — near-black with a violet undertone

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light canvas, notification card surfaces, text on dark — the dominant surface color in the upper page

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, ghost button fills — the structural ink of the system

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary text, subdued body copy — reads softer than pure black for paragraph-length content

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, metadata, timestamps in notification cards

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, disabled states, inactive nav items

fog.$description: Fog — Placeholder text, dimmed labels, low-priority metadata

silver.$description: Silver — Hairline borders, card outlines, subtle dividers, very light surface tint

linen.$description: Linen — Warm off-white surface — alternate card background, subtle tonal shift from pure white

ash.$description: Ash — Cool gray for pressed states and slightly cooler text — the only neutral with a slight blue cast

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

system-ui.$description: Primary typeface for the entire system — covers display headlines, navigation, body copy, and UI labels. Weight 700 dominates display sizes (56px, 32px) for the bold announcement-board voice; 500–600 for nav and emphasis; 400 for body. The choice of system-ui over a custom typeface is itself a signature: it reads native on every device and inherits the platform's voice rather than imposing a foreign one.

eb-garamond.$description: Editorial serif accent for emphasis moments — tight line-height (0.90) and 700 weight give it a display-poster quality. Used sparingly, probably for tagline or feature emphasis where the sans-serif would feel too uniform.
